content.text: {"root_causes":[{"service":"ts-travel-plan-service","fault_kind":"http_response_body_corrupted","evidence":[{"kind":"trace","sql":"SELECT p.service_name AS parent_svc, p.span_name AS parent_span, p.attr_span_kind AS parent_kind, p.attr_http_request_method AS parent_method, c.service_name AS child_svc, c.span_name AS child_span, c.attr_http_request_method AS child_method, count(*) AS n FROM abnormal_traces c JOIN abnormal_traces p ON c.parent_span_id = p.span_id AND c.trace_id = p.trace_id WHERE c.service_name = 'ts-route-plan-service' AND c.attr_http_request_method = 'OPTIONS' GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY n DESC","claim":"1447 OPTIONS requests reached route-plan, all parented by travel-plan's outgoing POST client spans; the method was rewritten in transit."},{"kind":"trace","sql":"SELECT service_name, span_name, attr_http_request_method, attr_http_response_status_code, count(*) AS c FROM abnormal_traces WHERE service_name = 'ts-travel-plan-service' AND attr_span_kind = 'Server' AND span_name = 'POST /api/v1/travelplanservice/travelPlan/quickest' GROUP BY ALL","claim":"All 1447 travel-plan /travelPlan/quickest server spans returned HTTP 500 in the abnormal window."},{"kind":"log","sql":"SELECT service_name, level, message, count(*) AS c FROM abnormal_logs WHERE service_name = 'ts-travel-plan-service' AND level = 'SEVERE' GROUP BY ALL","claim":"travel-plan logged 1447 SEVERE NullPointerException errors from dispatcherServlet, matching the failing quickest requests."}]}],"propagation":[{"from":"ts-travel-plan-service","to":"ts-ui-dashboard","evidence":[{"kind":"trace","sql":"SELECT service_name, span_name, count(*) AS c, sum(CASE WHEN attr_status_code = 'Error' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS errs, approx_quantile(duration, 0.95)/1e6 AS p95_ms FROM abnormal_traces WHERE service_name = 'ts-ui-dashboard' AND attr_span_kind = 'Server' AND span_name = 'POST /api/v1/travelplanservice/travelPlan/quickest' GROUP BY ALL","claim":"ui-dashboard's quickest requests: 83 of 100 errored, p95 about 4088 ms, as travel-plan's 500s surface to users."}]}]}
